editorial.how_we_test: We evaluate AI investing tools through reproducible back-testing against historical market data. Every performance claim on this site is backed by a published, repeatable methodology.
editorial.how_we_make_money: We may earn an affiliate commission when you purchase tools through our links. This does not affect our testing methodology or results.
editorial.corrections: If you find a factual error or a flaw in our methodology, please contact us. We publish corrections prominently alongside the original analysis.
